_comment: The standing airspace list (docs/adr/0098 §10), keyed by the theater name DCS-gRPC's GetTheatre returns. Each id is imported into the registry once (a later delete is not resurrected; a later addition lands); after that the panel's edits live in the Board snapshot. A copy in state/efsp-airspaces.json replaces this file whole, and is as strict: a definition that does not validate, or two JURISDICTION areas sharing volume, stops start-up. JURISDICTION areas (docs/adr/0125, decisions H142-H146): whose airspace an aircraft is in. Altitudes are feet MSL; a null altLowerFt is the surface and a null altUpperFt unlimited. Outside every area the airspace is CENTER's (Class E); a Class G area is nobody's; a carrier circle wins wherever it is; no two other areas may overlap, so RAPCON excludes the tower's control zone. Sources: LTAG-CZ is AIP Türkiye AD 2 LTAG AD 2.17 (page dated 14 MAY 26) verbatim; LTAG-RAPCON's lateral limits are the Adana MTMA of AIP Türkiye ENR 2.1.3 (AIRAC AMDT 08/26), its SFC floor is the squadron's (H143) and its class C is ours; the carrier control area (50 nm, SFC-UNL) is the squadron's (H142), its class E ours.

Syria.name: LTAG CTR (control zone)
Syria.sourceText: AIP Türkiye LTAG AD 2.17 (14 MAY 26), Incirlik CTR: Circle radius 5 NM centered on 370012N-0352530E except the part of the circle north west of a straight line joining 365906N-0351925E and 370432N-0352837E. SFC-3000ft. Class D and the owners LC, GC are the squadron's (H145).

Syria.name: Incirlik RAPCON (Adana MTMA)
Syria.sourceText: AIP Türkiye ENR 2.1.3 (AIRAC AMDT 08/26), Adana MTMA: Centered on 365956N-0352559E, Radius 50 NM, FL280 / 2000FT AMSL, Incirlik Approach. Floor lowered to SFC by the squadron (H143); the LTAG CTR's volume is cut out (H144); class C is ours.

Syria.name: CVN-72 CCA (carrier control area)
Syria.sourceText: The carrier's area (H142): a 50 nm circle on the live hull, surface to unlimited, owned by the CARRIER Positions; it wins over every other area. Class E is ours.
